description:
Activate Aetheric Amplifier by paying {4} and tapping it, doubling the charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Magistrate's Scepter
uses.cardState: with three or more charge counters on it
